description: Return the ClinicalTrials.gov study data model as a tree of module nodes (each with name/title/type/children). Use this to explore what fields/modules exist and their nesting, to build `fields` selections or `sort`/filter expressions. GET /studies/metadata.

includeHistoricOnly.description: Include fields that exist only in historic study versions.

includeIndexedOnly.description: Include fields that are indexed-only (searchable but not part of the main data model).

name: get_study_metadata
title: Get the study data-model (field tree)
